cases.name: Amy R. Ford
cases.about: Her Go Fund Me said, "She was kind and caring and loved her children with all that she had. She deserves to be brought back home to where she was from and for her family to have closure. Her children deserve to have their mom at peace."
cases.narrative: On 9/20/2023, her body was found, along with the body of Linda Estrada, in Kiowa County in rural eastern Colorado.

cases.name: Linda L. Estrada
cases.about: On her Go Fund Me, her sister Rachel Rios said, "My sister was a beautiful person inside and out. She was always willing to help other's in need, whether it was mowing the grass or painting. She cared for her family and was always there for her kids. She was a caring and loving person."
cases.narrative: On 9/20/2023, her body was found, along with the body of Amy Ford, in Kiowa County in rural eastern Colorado.
